bead.title: bench-pr-A1c: task-executors/harbor wrapper + task-executor listing + CONTRACT
bead.description:
PROBLEM: There is no host-side bash task executor that runs a graded Harbor task via the containerized runner; the Go runner invokes the harbor binary directly on the host. The bash runner (A3) needs a task-executor adapter that shells out to `docker run` the harbor-runner image, returns a result.json, and records runner provenance into the sweep.

ROOT CAUSE: cmd/bench/matrix.go runMatrixHarbor builds harbor args and runs opts.harborBin directly on the host with repo-root PYTHONPATH (the `// Add repo root to PYTHONPATH ...` block, ~lines 1117-1129); harborAgentArgs (~lines 1014-1026) is the only thing selecting the harbor plugin. No scripts/benchmark/task-executors/harbor wrapper drives the container.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/task-executors/harbor: bash wrapper with a '# SUMMARY:' header; reads task-spec.json on stdin; docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$cell_dir:/output" -v "$tasks_dir:/tasks:ro" -e FIZEAU_API_KEY -e FIZEAU_BASE_URL -e FIZEAU_MODEL fizeau-harbor-runner:latest run --agent-import-path "$harbor_plugin" --task-id "$task_id" --output /output (harbor_plugin sourced from the harness adapter's install-spec.json); writes cell_dir/result.json; records task_executor_version + harbor_runner_image_digest into <out>/sweep.json for copy into each cell.
- ./benchmark task-executors: list every task executor with its '# SUMMARY:' line.
- scripts/benchmark/task-executors/CONTRACT.md: document the task-spec.json (stdin) and result.json shapes, the sweep.json provenance fields, and the '# SUMMARY:' convention.

NON-SCOPE: harbor-runner Docker image + build script (sibling A1a — consumed here, not built); shell harness-adapters set + their listing/contract (sibling A1b); runtime-probe.sh (sibling A1d); runner dispatch/--plan/matrix expansion (A2); per-cell execution loop, resume/retry, report compose (A3); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); Go changes, deactivation, parity (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor bench-set schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: parent fizeau-163efede; sibling A1a (consumes the fizeau-harbor-runner:latest image + build script) and the harbor_plugin emission convention from sibling A1b. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. ./benchmark task-executors lists every task executor with its '# SUMMARY:' line. Test: Test_AdapterListing_TaskExecutors (scripts/benchmark/tests/adapters.bats).
2. task-executors/harbor reads task-spec.json on stdin, issues the documented `docker run ... fizeau-harbor-runner:latest run ...` invocation (asserted against a stub docker on PATH), writes cell_dir/result.json, and records task_executor_version + harbor_runner_image_digest into sweep.json. Test: Test_TaskExecutorHarbor_Invocation (scripts/benchmark/tests/harbor-runner.bats).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: task-executors/harbor drives the runner image via docker run, writes result.json, records sweep provenance, and self-lists with '# SUMMARY:' (Test_AdapterListing_TaskExecutors, Test_TaskExecutorHarbor_Invocation); go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
